title: Deep links handled only for the running app, with no auth intent preservation
notes: The reported symptom names the bug precisely: it works in testing because testing is done with the app already running. (1) Only Linking.addEventListener is registered — getInitialURL is absent, so a link that launches a killed app is never read. This is the primary finding. (2) Even with getInitialURL added, navigating immediately would be a no-op because the navigator is not mounted yet; the intent must be held until onReady. (3) A link to a protected order while signed out renders AuthStack and the target is dropped, so the user logs in and lands nowhere. (4) The id is extracted by string replace with no validation, and the host check is a naive split that matches any URL containing the substring. Tests whether the agent distinguishes the three entry paths rather than reading this as generic routing code.
